parsed.reason: The single pick is a real, specific venue in Ottawa that a visiting family can simply turn up to: the Canada Science and Technology Museum. It is sourced from its own organisation, Ingenium, and suits a preschooler. It is not a term, class or registration-driven programme, so it avoids the Labour Day fall-session trap. The pricing structure (youth 3-17, under-2 free, family rate) is plausible for Ingenium's published admission. The hours have two problems. The claimed Monday Aug 31 closure may not match the museum's summer schedule, which typically runs daily through late summer. Wed Sept 2 is not addressed. Only one find is thin coverage for a four-day visit, though one solid pick is better than padded ones. It is sound but not exemplary.
